Two Tankers Hit by Mines in Strait of Hormuz; Iran Accused

Two supertankers were struck by mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) reported the incident. Bahrain stated that Iran struck an industrial site, occurring concurrently with the tanker incidents.
